evidence.observation: System pressure dropped abruptly from ~649 mbar to 392-401 mbar
Reflux flow collapsed to ~0.005 L/h from ~0.33 L/h
Distillate flow jumped to 1.49/1.29 L/h from ~0.34 L/h
Column dP jumped from ~2 to ~6.9 mbar while PDI701 fell to 0.34
